description: CppStudio Claude-lane install transform. Applied by apply_claude_transform.py when sync_to_claude.sh stages a skill, so the COPY installed into ~/.claude/skills is Claude-provider-specific rather than a byte-mirror of the Codex-flavored source. Codex installs the source verbatim; Claude installs source -> this transform. Single source of truth (skills/), provider-specific deployment.

rationale.flip: Host-provider skill-home self-references. A Claude agent loads its sibling skills/scripts/donor-library from ~/.claude, never ~/.codex. On a Claude-only machine ~/.codex/skills/... does not exist, so these paths are broken until flipped; after install the same script DOES exist under ~/.claude/skills/...
rationale.keep: Supervised-worker lore and Codex-based external tools. A Claude host legitimately DRIVES a Codex worker / Codex CLI; these are not host self-references. agent-tmux only implements 'codex-code-map-sidecar' (requires a real, bwrap-isolated Codex executable) and has no 'claude-' variant, so flipping these would point at nonexistent commands.

ordered_replacements.reason: bootstrap_code_map.py is the generated-project shim that locates the installed CppStudio skill to run code-map scripts. On a Claude box it must search the Claude skill home (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / ~/.claude/skills), not ~/.codex. CPPSTUDIO_SKILL_ROOT remains the provider-agnostic explicit override.
Error message in the same bootstrap shim, pointing the user at the Claude skill home env var.

ordered_replacements.replace: python3 scripts/quick_validate_skill.py skills/cpp-cuda-vulkan-studio  # run from the CppStudio source repo; never edit the installed copy
ordered_replacements.reason: Codex's .system/skill-creator has no ~/.claude equivalent. The Claude-correct way to verify this skill is the source-repo validator (doctrine: edit source, re-roll out; do not patch the installed copy). MUST precede the generic ${HOME}/.codex/skills flip so the whole line is rewritten, not partially mangled.
Installed-skill script/donor self-reference resolved from the host provider's skill home.
Same host self-reference, tilde form (installed donor-library location, etc.).
Bare repo-local agent-policy path reference. Runs last so it does not partially rewrite the longer rules above (whose outputs already contain .claude/skills).

intentionally_kept.reason: Real agent-tmux subcommand; requires a bwrap-isolated real Codex executable. No claude- variant exists.
Codex-worker sandbox lore (read-only .git mountpoint, etc.); valid when a Claude host supervises a Codex worker.
Cross-provider read-only stuck-probe CLI a Claude host can call.
Codex worker launch option; a worker-launch choice, not a host self-reference.
